whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: Green-main minimal fix. (1) 0030 rewrite: static per-child DDL (no CREATE TEMP TABLE: PGlite 42501), people-parent guards via information_schema (postgres 42703), triggers statically visible to the rollback gate (26 F3-grandfathered drops). (2) 0031: departments removed from the afc_fill_scope fill list -- filling zone on a branch-scoped department violates 0027 departments_single_scope_check on every such insert (real product contradiction, caught by suites 85/92); down script mirrors the list. (3) New 0038: people first_name/last_name/branch(uuid FK) + grants (board-approved datamodel option on AFC-700); data-guarded down script. (4) Suites: 63 tripwire moved to the reviewed 0038 slice; 70 Z1 8->7 and others 20->19 (0029 removed the satellite, expectation never updated); 85.4/88.4 re-apply 0029 after the 0002 re-apply (resurrected SANGO-OTA/SAT-1 broke 87/89 counts); 86/88 re-apply idempotent 0030+0031 after their 0023 rollback re-apply (bare re-created registers broke 94 shape); 94 fill list drops departments (no fill trigger there by design, 19->18). Non-compliance in the same commit: prettier formatting of the 53 main-flagged files; type annotations in task-templates.ts, TaskViews.vue, default.vue, roles.vue (incl. selectRole/actionOptions/collectionOptions/filteredRolePermissions hoists so template expressions stay build-parseable JS), custom-grants.ts scope label fix.
whatThisFileIs: An R1 authorship claim, and nothing else.
